requirement: Baseline records branch/head, dirty work, relevant instructions, commands and production call graph.
notes: baseline identical to pack reviewed SHA

requirement: Tests expose each reviewed defect or document an independently verified later fix; failures occur for the intended reason.
Requirement-to-file/test mapping covers both paths, all core interactions and generation-enabled Learn content capabilities.
Every generation-enabled capability resolves instructions, exact schema, required inputs and registered validation/mode support.
A package-only instruction change reaches the actual writer request after regeneration without dispatcher edits.
Missing resources and unknown validators fail explicitly; generated exports pass drift checks.
Instruction/schema changes alter definition hash; old persisted releases are unchanged.
Both package adapters run through one shared invocation/repair mechanism with their own schemas.
Request capture proves unrelated schemas, catalogue data, other path settings and unrelated items are absent.
Malformed response is repaired with original scope plus precise errors; exhaustion persists a typed failure.
Missing inputs, unresolved definitions and unavailable provider fail rather than producing stubs.
Result provenance records work order, source identities, teaching revision, definition and input hashes; retries are bounded.
Normal Print entrypoint delivers selected package instructions and exact form schema to provider.
Table provider failure yields typed failure/retry; no Lit leaf/Covered leaf or other fixture content is produced.
Approved question/choice conversion preserves IDs, answer keys and student/teacher separation.
Offline regressions cover prose, list, table, aside, worked example, questions, choices and figure lifecycle where selectable.
Retrying one failed block preserves completed siblings; assembly/reload retains validated payloads and order.
Normal native Learn production invokes real content authoring; planning briefs are not final lesson payloads.
All eight core interactions support faithful approved conversion where compatible and configured provider generation where declared.
Known-answer regression cases pass; malformed/missing approved keys fail; no positional, number-extraction or last-word guesses remain.
Each core payload validates, renders in its actual component and evaluates expected answers; teacher-review remains unscored pending review.
Assembly performs no authoring and rejects missing, mismatched or unvalidated results instead of synthesizing content.
Content-specific schemas are respected, repeated content/activity ordering survives, and Builder edits preserve valid contracts.
Multiple eligible content/interaction options use configured selector; sole candidate selection remains deterministic.
Out-of-shortlist decisions are rejected and boundedly repaired; reordered catalogue does not cause a first-entry policy choice.
Required interactions/evidence cannot vanish; optional decisions follow explicit native policy.
Fallback cannot restore candidates excluded for assets
Missing learner action/source causes owning-stage repair/error; no order-items default or first-unused-source assignment.
Shared teaching inputs remain path-agnostic and both native outputs reference the same approved revision.
All mandatory offline gates have attributable commands, tested commit, results and evidence paths; none skipped or weakened.
Both normal production paths reach valid persisted drafts from the same revision using mocked external boundaries only.
Representative content, core interaction rendering/evaluation, invalid payload rejection, bounded recovery and reload are exercised.
Publish/edit/v2 local tests preserve v1 immutability and authoritative evaluation; retries do not create duplicate logical outputs.
Definition-edit propagation and defect regressions run through actual production interfaces
Final report separates completed offline work, unresolved implementation/environment blockers and deferred live/model-quality evidence.
